description: Canadair CT-133 Silver Star Mk 3 preserved at the gate of I Brigada Aérea, photographed in place 20 October 2025 (airhistory.net). The serial FAB-634 was issued twice: the first (ex French 21400/F-ZVLD) was scrapped at the Politécnico Militar in Cochabamba c.1997; this is the second, listed by Aerospotter as c/n T33-400. Visible from outside the base gate; coordinates are an OpenStreetMap aircraft node at the brigade entrance, unverified.
